name: Webhook: Quote Sync From Dealhub To CP
description:
This recipe automates the process of handling a "quote won" event from Dealhub via an HTTP webhook.

- The process begins when a webhook event is received, containing details about the Dealhub opportunity and quote.
- If the environment is set to "Dev", it searches for related opportunities in Salesforce using a SOQL query.
- The recipe then retrieves the quote details from Dealhub using an HTTP GET request.
- If the quote retrieval is successful, it updates the quote in another system via an HTTP PUT request.
- Upon successful update, a message is posted to a Slack channel with details about the new Dealhub won opportunity, including the external opportunity ID, Dealhub quote ID, the executor, and the status.
- If any step fails, an error message is raised and posted to the Slack channel for visibility.

Overall, this recipe ensures that when a quote is won in Dealhub, the relevant information is updated and communicated effectively to the team via Slack.

[Monday Item Link](https://brightdata-group.monday.com/boards/8667788707/pulses/18147031001)

# Inputs: input['answers'] = array of answer objects from DealHub

answers = input['answers'] || []

# Helper: find an answer by question_id and clean it (strip wrapping quotes + whitespace)
def get_answer(answers, qid)
  found = answers.find { |a| a['question_id'] == qid }
  return nil if found.nil?
  raw = found['answer'].to_s.strip
  raw.gsub(/\A"|"\z/, '').strip  # remove surrounding quotes if present
end

quote_type         = get_answer(answers, 'Quote_Type')
quote_type_confirm = get_answer(answers, 'Quote_Type_Confirm')

# Exclusion rule — HIGHER priority than tiers
exclude_from_cp = (quote_type == 'Budgetary' && quote_type_confirm == 'Yes')

{
  'quote_type'         => quote_type,
  'quote_type_confirm' => quote_type_confirm,
  'exclude_from_cp'    => exclude_from_cp,
  'skip_reason'        => exclude_from_cp ? 'Budgetary quote — excluded from CP recipe' : ''
}

quote = input["quote"]
salesforce_result = input["account_zones"]

account_zones =
  if salesforce_result.is_a?(Array)
    salesforce_result
  elsif salesforce_result.is_a?(Hash)
    salesforce_result["records"] || []
  else
    []
  end

# Salesforce Display_Value__c => { zone_id, resource_id }
zone_lookup = {}

account_zones.each do |account_zone|
  display_value =
    account_zone["Display_Value__c"] ||
    account_zone["display_value__c"]

  zone_id =
    account_zone["Zone_ID__c"] ||
    account_zone["zone_id__c"]

  resource_id =
    account_zone["Resource_ID__c"] ||
    account_zone["resource_id__c"]

  next if display_value.to_s.strip.empty?
  next if zone_id.to_s.strip.empty?

  key = display_value.to_s.strip.downcase
  zone_lookup[key] = {
    "zone_id"     => zone_id,
    "resource_id" => resource_id
  }
end

transform = nil

transform = lambda do |value|
  if value.is_a?(Hash)
    new_hash = {}

    # Find whether this object has a matching Zone.
    zone_key = value.keys.find do |key|
      key.to_s.downcase == "zone"
    end

    matching = nil

    if zone_key
      zone_value = value[zone_key]

      unless zone_value.to_s.strip.empty?
        normalized_zone = zone_value.to_s.strip.downcase
        matching = zone_lookup[normalized_zone]
      end
    end

    matching_zone_id     = matching && matching["zone_id"]
    matching_resource_id = matching && matching["resource_id"]

    value.each do |key, nested_value|
      # If a match exists, remove old zone_id / resource_id so they
      # can be reinserted immediately after Zone.
      if key.to_s.downcase == "zone_id" && matching_zone_id
        next
      end

      if key.to_s.downcase == "resource_id" && matching_resource_id
        next
      end

      new_hash[key] = transform.call(nested_value)

      # Insert zone_id then resource_id immediately after Zone.
      if key.to_s.downcase == "zone" && matching_zone_id
        new_hash["zone_id"] = matching_zone_id
        new_hash["resource_id"] = matching_resource_id if matching_resource_id
      end
    end

    new_hash

  elsif value.is_a?(Array)
    value.map do |item|
      transform.call(item)
    end

  else
    value
  end
end

enriched_quote = transform.call(quote)

{
  "result" => {
    "environment" => input["env"]
  }.merge(enriched_quote)
}
